ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a reaction intermediate containing a C=N–O–PCl4 connection; the imine carbon is connected to R1 and R2, and the nitrogen is connected to the O–PCl4 group. There are two curved arrows in the figure: one indicates migration of the R1-related bond/electrons toward the nitrogen atom, and the other indicates movement of the N–O bond electrons toward the O–PCl4 leaving group. Reasoning: According to this arrow-pushing process, the N–O bond breaks and the phosphorus-chloro-oxy group leaves; at the same time R1 migrates onto nitrogen. The remaining organic part can be represented as a nitrilium/iminium resonance form, in which carbon is connected to nitrogen by a double bond, carbon bears a positive charge, one wildcard substituent is on carbon, and the other wildcard substituent is on nitrogen. Therefore the corresponding SMILES is [*][C+]=N[*].

method.method_draft: First describe the drawing: identify the central C=N–O–PCl4 motif, with R1 and R2 attached to the imine carbon, and note the two curved arrows indicating R1 migration to N and N–O bond cleavage to the phosphoryl chloride leaving group. Apply the rearrangement rule: after migration, the organic cation is a nitrilium/iminium resonance form with one wildcard substituent on carbon and one wildcard substituent on nitrogen. Encode that state as a carbon cation double-bonded to nitrogen: [*][C+]=N[*].
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中显示一个含有 C=N–O–PCl4 连接的反应中间体；亚胺碳连接 R1 和 R2，氮连接到 O–PCl4 基团。图中有两条弯箭头：一条表示 R1 相关键/电子迁移到氮原子方向，另一条表示 N–O 键电子向 O–PCl4 离去基团方向移动。
推理：按照该箭推过程，N–O 键断裂，含磷氯氧基团离去；同时 R1 迁移到氮上。剩余有机部分可表示为腈鎓/亚胺鎓共振形式，其中碳与氮双键相连，碳带正电，一个通配取代基在碳上，另一个通配取代基在氮上。因此对应 SMILES 为 [*][C+]=N[*]。

method.method_draft: Track the electrons shown in the image step by step. Move the C–R1 bonding pair to make an N–R1 bond, move the N–O bonding pair onto the leaving OPCl4 group, and keep the C=N connection in the organic fragment. Then assign formal charges by valence: nitrogen has normal valence through double bond to carbon plus single bond to the migrated R group, while carbon is short one electron pair and is written as [C+]. Replace R1/R2 with [*] and write the organic product state as [*][C+]=N[*].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个箭推机理图。中心有一个与 R1、R2 相连的碳，并与左上方的 N 形成 C=N 连接；N 还连到右侧的 OPCl4 基团。图中一条弯箭表示 C–R1 键的电子对迁移到 N 上形成 N–R1 键，另一条弯箭表示 N–O/OPCl4 方向的键电子转移到离去的 OPCl4 基团。推理：按箭头移动电子后，R1 从碳迁移到氮，氮保持与碳的双键并再与迁移来的 R 基相连；OPCl4 作为离去基团脱离。碳失去原来的 C–R1 键电子对后在有机片段中电子不足，因此写为带正电的 [C+]。将 R1/R2 都用通配原子 [*] 表示，产物有机状态为 [*][C+]=N[*]。
